name: kolpulse-discovery
description: Follow practice-changing social media discussions and treatment controversies from recent oncology and hematology meetings (ESMO, WCLC, ASCO GU, EHA, IMS, and others). Name a clinical trial and a meeting, or start from a tumor type to pick one recent meeting. See what verified global KOLs posted — verbatim quotes, inline tweet links, Open Payments context, and links to KOL Pulse trial pages. One conference at a time. Not medical advice.
